summary: Q1 revise-apply completed both 135-review-apply Blocking Findings by completing the existing shared invariants — no new validator, no scope expansion. (Q1-RA-007) source-review requiredness is now Action-owned: requiresTuple is decided by the Action alone (revise-explore / revise-propose / revise-apply) in BOTH terminal preflight (completionPreflight) and the FormalFact Reader (validateImmutableRunResultRefs); the 135-flagged `&& sourceReviewRun !== undefined` gate is deleted. The shared validateSourceReviewTuple now also proves the Action-owned lineage: expectedSourceReviewActionFor maps revise-explore→review-explore / revise-propose→review-propose / revise-apply→review-apply, the source review's admitted action must equal the expected stage (wrong-review-stage fails), and BOTH the admitted verdict and persisted sourceReviewVerdict must be changes-requested (verdict-not-changes-requested fails) — an internally-consistent approved tuple can no longer precede a revise-*. readAdmittedSourceReviewVerdicts now exposes the source review Run's action for the stage mapping. Negative fixtures cover: revise-explore and revise-apply with the entire tuple absent, revise-propose with a complete fresh produced set but no tuple (rejects on source-review requiredness, not artifact completeness), approved source review, and wrong-stage changes-requested source review — all reject at completeRun without publishing result.json, and persisted historical versions produce Reader conflicts (immutable-ref-required / immutable-ref-verdict-not-cr / immutable-ref-wrong-stage), with superseded/revision-window immutable evidence still strict. (Q1-RA-010) validateActionResultApplicability now receives the top-level runStatus and enforces the required/forbidden matrix from runStatus==completed + context.action, NOT actionResult.executionStatus: a top-level completed review-apply MUST carry verificationSummaryRef regardless of executionStatus (completed/failed/blocked); a top-level completed artifact-producing Run MUST structurally carry producedResultRefs (presence at physical admission; full exact-set/bytes remain owned by validateStageEffectiveSet); producedResultRefs stays forbidden on non-artifact Actions, verificationSummaryRef only on review-apply, reviewVerdictRef forbidden on review-*. admitC1RunResult and terminal preflight share the same semantics, and a superseded-in-shape historical propose missing producedResultRefs still produces a run-result-schema conflict at physical admission (superseded only relaxes mutable current-byte comparison, never physical Action-result shape). Regression checks confirm RA-001/003/005/006/008/009 remain resolved and exact generation/archive behavior is preserved. All verification actually executed and passed: typecheck, lint, build, 584 tests (584 pass, 0 fail), OpenSpec change strict, canonical specs strict, git diff --check. Delivery Full Test was NOT run (no authorization for revise-apply). No contract artifacts, prior Runs, or Flowkit state were modified; no Git commit was created by this Run.

resolvedFindings.evidence: requiresTuple is now decided by the Action alone in both production call sites (run-persistence.ts completionPreflight and formal-fact-reader.ts validateImmutableRunResultRefs): `requiresTuple: action === 'revise-explore' || action === 'revise-propose' || action === 'revise-apply'` — the 135-blocked `&& sourceReviewRun !== undefined` is deleted. validateSourceReviewTuple (result-ref-adapter.ts) adds the Action-owned lineage proof: expectedSourceReviewActionFor maps revise-explore→review-explore / revise-propose→review-propose / revise-apply→review-apply; an admitted source review whose action does not match produces a wrong-review-stage problem; an admitted verdict != changes-requested or persisted sourceReviewVerdict != changes-requested produces a verdict-not-changes-requested problem. readAdmittedSourceReviewVerdicts now reads the source review Run's context.action so the stage mapping can run at terminal preflight; the Reader passes each admitted ReviewVerdictFact's Run action from the runs index. Negative fixtures (run-persistence.test): revise-explore and revise-apply with the entire tuple absent → completeRun rejects SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED and result.json is not published; revise-propose with a complete fresh proposal/design/tasks/specs set but NO tuple → still rejects (proving requiredness, not artifact completeness); revise-propose sourced from an APPROVED review (path/hash/verdict internally consistent) → rejects; revise-propose sourced from a WRONG-STAGE changes-requested review-explore → rejects. Reader fixtures (formal-fact-reader.test): persisted revise-explore with no tuple → immutable-ref-required; persisted revise-propose sourced from an approved review → immutable-ref-verdict-not-cr; source review B readable+correct-hash but wrong target stage → immutable-ref-target/verdict conflict; superseded-generation tampered reviewVerdictRef (integration) → immutable-ref-mismatch.

validateActionResultApplicability(contextAction, runStatus, actionResult) (serialization.ts) now derives requiredness from the top-level physical runStatus + context.action, never from actionResult.executionStatus. Required matrix enforced: runStatus==completed + artifact-producing Action (explore/revise-explore/propose/revise-propose) ⇒ producedResultRefs MUST be structurally present (full exact-set/current bytes stay owned by validateStageEffectiveSet); runStatus==completed + review-apply ⇒ verificationSummaryRef MUST be present regardless of executionStatus=completed|failed|blocked; producedResultRefs forbidden on non-artifact Actions; verificationSummaryRef only on review-apply; reviewVerdictRef forbidden on review-*. admitC1RunResult passes result.runStatus into the validator and completionPreflight passes the terminal runStatus, so Writer and Reader share the exact same required/forbidden matrix. Negative fixtures (serialization.test): admitC1RunResult rejects top-level completed review-apply with executionStatus=failed and executionStatus=blocked (both missing verificationSummaryRef), and top-level completed explore / propose / revise-propose without producedResultRefs; accepts completed explore with producedResultRefs and completed review-apply with verificationSummaryRef. Reader fixture (formal-fact-reader.test): a superseded-in-shape historical propose missing producedResultRefs (with a legal R0→P1 chain present) still produces a run-result-schema conflict at physical admission — superseded generation semantics never exempt physical Action-result shape.
